description: Check whether a CN/HS/TARIC code falls within EUDR Annex I. Use this for one code; eudr_list_products returns the full catalogue and cbam_get_default_values covers CBAM emissions. Returns verdict (yes/partly/some_codes_below/no), meaning, matches, removed products, applies_from, sources and verified. A short heading can return some_codes_below: pass a longer code; partly requires checking the product description on an ex line. Bundled official acts and verified date bound freshness; this is product scope information, not a due-diligence filing. Free keyless allowance: 10 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

cn.description: CN/HS/TARIC code or prefix, 2 to 10 digits after removing spaces and dots, e.g. 0901

name: eudr_check_scope
title: Check EUDR product scope
